summary: Payment security implementation is sound and complete. All three migrations (065, 066, 067) correctly implement the payment-first flow: nullable submission_id schema enables pre-payment recording, record_payment_transaction accepts dual modes (pre/post payment), and submit_response links and verifies atomically. Frontend correctly reorders the flow (payment first with null submission_id, then submit). Six integration tests cover all critical paths including bypass prevention, signature verification, and backward compatibility. No SQL syntax errors, no TypeScript errors, no logic gaps. The nullable FK with check constraint cleanly solves the chicken-and-egg problem. The 1-hour staleness window prevents payment reuse. HMAC verification is preserved unchanged. Audit logging captures bypass attempts. Backward compatibility maintained for forms without payments or with legacy payment configurations. Ready for deployment after user approval and manual migration execution in Supabase SQL Editor.
